name: Donut
summary: Ring donut with pink icing drips and sprinkles, for dessert, breakfast and sweets scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the donut rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (~360 px wide); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: icing
params.note: icing colour, e.g. pink, chocolate #5E3B26, white #FFFFFF

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, wobble = small rock, pop = scale in with overshoot

author: krakujs
